checks.equipment: Plate-loaded sled with two upright handles
checks.setup: 슬레드의 양쪽 기둥을 잡고 상체를 앞으로 기울인다. 복부에 힘을 주고 허리를 길게 유지한다.
checks.hands: Closed grips remain attached to handles
checks.feet: Alternating steps, continuous support, stance fixed after camera travel correction
checks.movement: 양발로 바닥을 번갈아 밀며 슬레드를 앞으로 이동시킨다. 손잡이를 계속 잡고 몸통의 기울기를 유지한다.

limitations: Procedural demonstration, not captured human motion.
Camera follows the athlete and sled; no floor is rendered.
Two slowed gait cycles in eight seconds.
Sampled base-platform clearance; not exhaustive equipment collision or force simulation.
